description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Yuffie - Water)], [Ninja Resonance +5% Boost], [Physical Blink Stacking 2] and [Awoken Gauntlet] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Yuffie - Water)
description.text: Ninja abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Ninja abilities

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2

description.name: Awoken Gauntlet
description.text: Grants [Physical Blink 1] after using a Ninja ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode II (Yuffie - Water)], removes [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Yuffie - Water)]
